# RockxyBase 0.1.0 (build 1)
The first release of RockxyBase.
### Added
- Connect to PostgreSQL 17 (including Supabase and Neon) and SQL Server 2022, over TLS by default, directly or through an SSH tunnel; credentials are stored in the macOS Keychain. - SQL editor with completion, query plans, transactions and per-tab cancellation, and a native result grid with sorting, filtering, copy and export. - Explore tables and results with database-computed profiles, distributions and outliers. - A semantic model — relationships, measures and calculated fields — to ask questions without writing every join. - Native charts and multi-page reports with slicers, drill-down, drill-through and cross-filtering; reports can be exported and shared as `.rockxybasereport` files. - Import CSV and Excel files into a local SQLite database. - Read-only connections enforced below the interface, and previews before schema or row changes run. - Signed automatic updates.
